title: KemboGreen
description: Comprehensive marketing identity and 8K cinematic video advertisement featuring 20L containers and farm-to-field storytelling.
challenge: Create a premium organic identity that earns trust in a traditionally low-trust commodity market.
solution: Developed earthy yet bold visual language — deep greens with gold accents — paired with an 8K cinematic campaign shot on-location at partner farms.
results: 42% increase in retail shelf recognition within the first quarter post-launch.

title: On The Way
description: Complete visual storefront identity including 6-bay glass vinyl graphics, neon signs, and a unified day-to-night aesthetic system.
challenge: Design a storefront that feels premium at 3 AM and still welcoming at 7 AM, for a brand new 24-hour convenience concept.
solution: Layered neon, frosted glass vinyl, and warm backlit menu boards to create a distinct late-night energy that transforms beautifully in daylight.
results: Opened to 200+ first-day customers driven purely by foot traffic drawn by the exterior branding.

title: Olix Star
description: Minimalist and professional aesthetics for office glass partitions and interior branding across a multi-floor corporate HQ.
challenge: Transform a sterile open-plan floor into a branded environment that communicates trust and luxury to high-net-worth property buyers.
solution: Frosted glass partitions with precision-cut logo films, matte-black dimensional letters, and a curated palette of charcoal, white, and gold.
results: Clients reported 30% higher perceived brand confidence during in-office sales consultations.
